name: Glenn Olds
desc: American academic administrator, government official and politician (1921-2006)
summary:
Glenn A. Olds (February 28, 1921 – March 11, 2006) was an American academic administrator, government official and politician.  Olds was raised in Oregon and attended Willamette University.
Olds served as the president of Springfield College in western Massachusetts from 1958 to 1965, of Kent State University in Ohio from 1971 to 1977, and of Alaska Pacific University from 1977 to 1988.
